name: Level_2 - Task_7
description:
Measure the volumetric thermal expansion of bulk aluminum over 300–500 K at 1.01325 bar from volume changes at constant pressure and independently from pressure changes at fixed volume. Start from the supplied periodic 108-atom FCC aluminum cell and use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model throughout. Choose and justify numerical settings, temperature sampling, equilibration, production lengths, and measurement frequency. Record velocity initialization and random seeds, remove center-of-mass momentum, and initialize velocities only once for the NPT sequence.

Run one continuous isotropic NPT heating-then-cooling sequence without resetting positions or velocities. Include heating stages at 300, 400, and 500 K and return stages at 400 and 300 K; choose additional stages as needed. Establish equilibration and assess temperature and pressure control using measured data. Report stage mean measured temperatures and volumes. Define the main interval coefficient β_volume as the slope of a linear fit of heating mean volume against mean measured temperature over 300–500 K, divided by the heating 300 K mean volume. Report fit residuals. Separately estimate the local volumetric expansion coefficient at 400 K, recording the local analysis method and data selection. Quantify heating–cooling volume differences at 300 and 400 K.

Set V* to the heating 400 K mean volume. Design fixed-cell NVT calculations near (400 K, V*) with defensible temperature and volume perturbations to infer the isothermal bulk modulus B_T and pressure-route expansion coefficient β_pressure. Demonstrate that the sampled response supports local derivatives. Use total hydrostatic pressure including the kinetic contribution; document stress sign conventions and unit conversions. Treat positive B_T as a stability diagnostic and investigate any failure. Report the signed difference between β_pressure and the local NPT estimate without forcing agreement.

Report both expansion estimates in K⁻¹, the local NPT coefficient, B_T with units, and comparison diagnostics. Submit production trajectories containing cells, positions, momenta, and potential energies; time-indexed raw virial stress and total-pressure records; raw logs; restartable stage-boundary states; and settings, scripts, and structured JSON analysis data sufficient to reproduce the estimates and assess equilibration, sampling, response fits and continuity.
submission_format:
Fill in the blank manifest below and submit its path inside the task workspace
(for example, output/manifest.json). Linked paths may be relative to the manifest.
Replace null, empty strings and arrays with your results, file paths and data;
repeat example records and replace <...> keys with your actual identifiers.
Fixed units and method names describe the illustrated format. Where the task
leaves a method open, choose and record your method. Retain raw evidence and
calculations for any alternative method; unsupported calculations require
independent review before a final score.
